source_note: Measurements use frozen trees. The two lookup implementations change. The candidate formatter also reorders one import list in compile_vapor/src/compilation/vapor/script.rs; its executable code is unchanged. All three changed source files are archived. Concurrent work is excluded. Promotion adds a Clippy line-count expectation to validation.rs. The layout example and its CSS dev dependency are measurement tools added after the compiler snapshots. The archived as-used profiler predates the final guard for undefined zero-access miss rates; populated measured rates are unchanged.

environment.allocation_build: release with metrics, separate target directories

models.64: 32 KiB I1, 32 KiB D1, 8 MiB LL; 8/8/16 ways; 64-byte lines
models.128: 192 KiB I1, 128 KiB D1, 12 MiB LL; assumed 3/8/12 ways; 128-byte lines
models.capacity_note: 128-byte model capacities and line size match sysctl values for performance cores. Associativities are assumptions. This is not a model of the full M1 microarchitecture.

cpu_note: Process hardware cycles and instructions, 2000 rounds per process, 24 samples per population in ABBA order. All process threads are included. Core placement is not pinned. Shared-host cycle ranges overlap; these are observed medians.
cache_note: Three rounds per process, twelve samples per population and model. Process totals include loader, cold first round and warm later rounds. Cachegrind miss counts are simulation, not measured hardware misses.

hardware_cache.reason: Linux VM has no supported PMU events, including with CAP_PERFMON. perf reports all six hardware events as not supported. macOS proc_pid_rusage reports hardware cycles and instructions, not cache misses.

three_arm_note: Twenty shared inputs, three rounds per process and four samples per arm. Official Svelte uses Node --jitless for Valgrind profiling. These cache totals are not a comparison of normal JIT throughput.

controls.cache_locality: Strided access raises simulated D1 read misses by more than 4x and the real baseline gate rejects it.
controls.empty_workload: Rejected before a complete report is written.
controls.missing_raw_report: Old raw data is removed and a failed process is rejected.
controls.hardware_unavailable: Real Linux collector returns nonzero and UNMEASURED rather than reuse stale success.
controls.discarded_trial: Initial directories lacked .svelte suffixes and produced zero bytes. Its counters are excluded.
